findings.reason: a worker implementing §16 literally builds two doors that compute different keys, and the case titled "a resume racing a dispatch ... holds one reservation between them" then fails or, worse, is written to pin the wrong behaviour.
findings.text: §16 keeps §13's "one holder, one key" by having `launch_reservation_key` read the in-flight marker's attempt as it stands, yet the same section gives only the resume door a floor ("`reserve_launch_attempt` takes the record's next attempt as a floor on that door") — and in the very shape §16 exists to repair (a run whose only trace is `attempt.json` naming attempt 1, which §16's own done-when uses as a case) the resume door therefore reserves attempt 2 while a dispatch door racing it reserves attempt 1. Both reservations then create successfully at different `attempt-N` paths, and neither refuses the other, so the double launch §13 closed reopens on the marker-only shape; the marker's-attempt rule also makes the dispatch door relaunch attempt 1, the same number the dead marker already used

findings.reason: one added done-when line (run the identical pattern at the base revision and record the non-empty output) turns a vacuous absence into a falsifiable one, and the section otherwise owns no control at all.
findings.text: §17's whole measure is an absence (`git grep ... returns nothing`, plus an importer-population delta) and the section declares "Negative control: none", but nothing shows the grep can see the symbols it is about to report gone: at the reviewed base `e19d76aac8` the same pattern returns 16 hits (10 in `reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py`, 6 in `reckon/crew/resumption.py`) across `reckon/crew/resumption.py` and `reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py`, so a mistyped name, a dropped alternation or a wrong path in the delivered grep would report success while the machinery stayed

response_events.note: §16 drops the resume door's record floor. Every door computes one key from disk alone (newest receipt plus one; else the marker's attempt; else the dispatched attempt) and launches exactly the attempt it reserved, so a resume racing a dispatch on a marker-only run computes the same key and one is refused. A marker with no worker or exit receipt names an attempt that launched no worker, so reusing its number duplicates no receipt.
§17's done-when now runs the identical grep at the dispatch base and records its non-empty output as the positive control.
